title: Kelp incident impairs Yay! Staking agETH withdrawal path
description: A Kelp security incident beginning 2026-04-18 affected the Kelp-dependent ETH staking path used by Yay! Staking. Yay! paused new ETH staking and warned that unstaking could be delayed because it depended on Kelp contracts. On 2026-05-18 the Always Gain agETH vault remained closed even after rsETH resumed, and around 2026-05-25 Yay! reported the vault reopened and unstaking/withdrawals returned to normal.
notes: This is a bounded product/path-level withdrawal and unstaking impairment with documented recovery. It must not be generalized into Yay!-wide insolvency, project shutdown, or permanent customer loss.
